name: Pexafy API
description:
Semantic image search across free stock-photo libraries, among them Unsplash, Pexels and Pixabay, behind a single endpoint and a single response schema. The live list of sources is served by `GET /api/v1/facets/sources`.

One Pexafy request replaces the 3 to 5 provider calls, the response normalisation and the de-duplication you would otherwise write and maintain yourself.

## What it does

- **Natural-language search** — `a tired developer at a desk, warm lamp light` is ranked by meaning, not keyword overlap. Queries work in 100+ languages.
- **Image-to-image search** — post an image, get visually similar ones.
- **Filters** — colour (hex or name), orientation, licence, source, photographer, date.
- **One schema** — every photo carries the same fields whatever the source: id, urls, dimensions, dominant colours, photographer, licence and the attribution string to display.

## Access

- API key issued immediately at [pexafy.com/dashboard/api-keys/create](https://pexafy.com/dashboard/api-keys/create/) — no application review, no mandatory download-tracking callback.
- A free plan is available, no credit card required. Plans and quotas: [pexafy.com/pricing](https://pexafy.com/pricing/).
- Also exposed as an MCP server at `https://mcp.pexafy.com/mcp` for LLM clients ([details](https://pexafy.com/mcp/)).
